info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Update Payment By Param1-spec
info.description: The Payment Update API allows businesses to modify existing payment details within the financial gateway by utilizing a unique parameter identifier. This endpoint enables users to update relevant payment information seamlessly, ensuring accurate transaction processing and reconciliation. Typical consumers of this API include financial institutions, ecommerce platforms, and payment processors that require dynamic adjustments to payment records. Its flexible design facilitates smooth integration into various banking operations, enhancing user experience and operational efficiency.

patch.description: This operation allows for updating the details of a specific financial gateway payment identified by its unique reference (RES-100045). It supports modifications to various attributes of the payment, enabling flexibility in managing financial transactions.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to update the financial gateway resource identified by RES-100045. It contains the necessary data for patching the existing resource with the desired changes. Ensure that all required fields are provided according to the defined schema.

200.description: The update was successful and the resource is returned.
